title: showcase smoke: the boot-splash wait matches the English text "Initializing application", which objectui#12187 changes, so the objectui pin bump that carries it turns the wait into a silent pass
body:
Filing class: **④ coordination node.** One objectui change, and the objectstack test that has to move with it at the pin bump that carries it.

- **Who acts:** the seat that bumps `.objectui-sha` past PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12203's merge. Today's pin is `e5311165` (`e23eccb16`), which does not carry it. If another seat owns `examples/app-showcase/e2e`, triage routes it there instead. The change can also land before the bump, because it is harmless on today's pin (below).
- **Dedupe:** an objectstack issue search for "showcase smoke BOOT_SPLASH Initializing application boot splash regex objectui pin", closed included, returned 0 hits.
- **Found by:** the contract review of PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12203 (record `6120238134`, item R1), escalated to the `domain:ui` @ objectui seat 1 (`session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`, seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560). The seat confirmed it at objectstack `main` `712361b7a`.

## What changes in objectui

PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12203 is item 1 of objectstack-ai/objectui#12187. It changes the console boot screen (`LoadingScreen` in `@object-ui/app-shell`) as follows:

- The line it shows, `console.initializing`, reads "Opening your console…" in `en` instead of "Initializing application…". All ten built-in packs change with it.
- The line is now in the user's language from the first paint, not English until the first re-render.
- The three staged steps and the "new environment" hint are gone.

## What breaks here, and why nothing will say so

`examples/app-showcase/e2e/showcase-smoke.spec.ts` declares:

```ts
const BOOT_SPLASH = /Initializing application/i;
```

It uses it twice. First, the render wait: `mainText.length > 0 && !BOOT_SPLASH.test(mainText)`. Second, the deadline assertion: `expect(mainText, …).not.toMatch(BOOT_SPLASH)`. The file's own comment records why: QA run #21056 read the splash as the first `<main>` text on 22 of 49 surfaces.

Once the pin carries objectui#12203, the regex matches nothing the splash shows. The wait then returns on the splash's own text, and the assertion passes on a surface still on the splash. That is the false green #21056 found, and it comes back without a red check.

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` names the same line, "('Initializing application…')", in its boot-splash clause.

## Suggested fix (the acting seat decides)

- **Smallest:** match both lines, `/Initializing application|Opening your console/i`. It is correct on today's pin and after the bump, so it can land first.
- ⚠️ **Either spelling is still English-only.** The splash now follows the browser's language. So on a non-`en` run it shows, for example, 「正在打开你的控制台…」, and the English pattern misses it. The robust form is a language-independent marker on the splash. objectui's `LoadingScreen` has none today. If the acting seat wants one, it is an objectui card (`domain:ui`), and this seat will take it.
- **The checklist clause** in `platform-core.json` follows whichever form lands.

## Related

PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12203 · objectstack-ai/objectui#12187 · contract review `6120238134` · objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 (its change, `e23eccb16`, is the last commit that moved the pin)
